company_name: Semiplastic High Purity Material (Kunshan) Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — Semiplastic High Purity Material specializes in advanced plastic materials used in semiconductor fabrication and related high-tech industries.
summary: Founded in 1985, Semiplastic High Purity Material (Kunshan) Co., Ltd has evolved into a supplier of advanced plastic materials, particularly for semiconductor fabs' ultrapure water systems and precision engineering applications. The company offers a diverse range of high-purity plastic materials that enhance manufacturing processes across various high-tech sectors.
capabilities: Extrusion and precision processing of plastics

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Kunshan, China, and serves various high-tech industries within the region.
